module origen_023527(
    input wire start,
    input wire clockMul,
    input wire [15:0] mult1,
    input wire [15:0] mult2,
    output reg done,
    output reg [31:0] produto
);

    reg [32:0] register;
    reg [16:0] soma;
    reg load;
    reg [1:0] estado;
    reg [4:0] count;

    always @(posedge clockMul) begin
        case (estado)
            2'b00: begin // Idle state
                if (start) begin
                    estado <= 2'b01;
                    done <= 1'b0;
                    load <= 1'b1;
                    count <= 5'b00000;
                end
            end

            2'b01: begin // Initialization state
                register <= {17'b0, mult2};
                estado <= 2'b10;
                load <= 1'b0;
            end

            2'b10: begin // Add state
                if (register[0]) begin
                    soma <= register[32:16] + mult1;
                    register[32:16] <= soma;
                end
                estado <= 2'b11;
            end

            2'b11: begin // Shift state
                register <= {1'b0, register[32:1]};
                count <= count + 1;
                if (count == 5'b10000) begin // 16 iterations completed
                    estado <= 2'b00;
                    done <= 1'b1;
                    produto <= register[31:0];
                end else begin
                    estado <= 2'b10;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule
